note: Precommitted before any gate run. Rules are advisory evidence gates only: a PASS never executes a dispatch, trade or allocation, and a HOLD is the safe default on any missing, invalid or unverified evidence.

tasks.title: CAISO NP15 dispatch gate: run only while the verified LMP is at or below the precommitted ceiling

rule.label: Verified grid price at or below 150 USD/MWh

tasks.title: NYISO Zone J dispatch gate: run only while the verified LMP is at or below the precommitted ceiling

rule.label: Verified grid price at or below 150 USD/MWh

tasks.title: Treasury venue screen: pass only while the verified protocol TVL is at or above the precommitted floor

rule.label: Verified protocol TVL at or above 1,000,000,000 USD

tasks.title: Execution screen: pass only while the verified executable quote for 1 ETH meets the precommitted minimum output

rule.label: Verified executable output for 1 ETH at or above 1,000 USDC

tasks.title: Settlement check: pass only when the verified lookup places the transaction in a block

rule.label: Verified block number at least 1 (transaction settled)

tasks.title: Diligence screen: pass only while the verified 10-Q count for Apple Inc. in calendar 2025 meets the precommitted minimum

rule.label: Verified 10-Q filing count at or above 3

tasks.title: Validator screen: pass only while the verified effective balance meets the precommitted minimum

rule.label: Verified effective balance at or above 31 ETH (gwei)
